there is no single tool that could be recommended as the best one, because the choice of the appropriate one depends on the application area, the users' experience and the type of task that the users are willing to perform.

the use of ontologies in the Semantic Web is still in its infancy.
the development of ontology management tools is still a challenge, since they are not able yet to provide a complete set of features and capabilities.
